name: Cross-scale edge phase disagreement
layers: Core TMI/RTP; upward-continued TMI at 150 m; GeoDAWN K/Th/U or ratio grids.
signature: Persistent magnetic edges with signed edge-normal radiometric derivative reversal or termination, rather than coincident large gradient magnitudes.
missing_fault_rationale: A buried discontinuity might remain visible at depth while shallow alteration changes across a concealed segment. Catalogue distance is not used as positive evidence.
difference: In inspected local code GPC uses RTP/gravity/depth/elevation orientation, while DCAP-LHC uses a magnetic contact with K/Th/hydro context; the signed radiometric derivative-termination interaction is not the same. Global novelty and a complete registry comparison remain unproved.
non_fault_mimic: Intrusive lithologic contacts or flight-block levelling seams.
expected_improvement: Highest qualitative information-gain potential in this shortlist; no numeric DTI projection.
viability: Not executable yet: the derived shared cache/digest is missing and the official GeoDAWN archives were listed but their bytes were not obtained.

name: Repeated drainage displacement graph
layers: Core detrended elevation (band 12), elevation slope (band 19), derived drainage graph; optional 3DEP high-resolution DEM.
signature: Repeated signed lateral offsets across independent tributaries, with graph-level agreement across scales instead of a single scarp maximum.
missing_fault_rationale: Displaced channels might reveal a transverse structure that has no continuous surface scarp and is absent from a trace catalogue.
difference: In inspected local code the terrain builder includes chi, slope and scarp features; repeated paired channel-displacement graph inference was not found. Global novelty and peer comparison remain unproved.
non_fault_mimic: Stream capture, fan avulsion or abandoned lake shorelines.
expected_improvement: Second qualitative rank; more independent evidence, but resolution risk. No numeric DTI projection.
viability: Not executable yet: raw coarse bands were restored, but the canonical derived cache is absent. The official 3DEP catalog listed tiles within the mirror-grid bounding rectangle; tile bytes, footprint coverage and alignment remain unverified.

name: Alteration-front termination pairs
layers: GeoDAWN K/Th/U or Th/K and U/K; independent magnetic edge or analytic-signal axes.
signature: Pair opposite-side along-strike terminations of alteration fronts across a magnetic edge; do not select merely high-ratio pixels.
missing_fault_rationale: An unmapped transverse structure may compartmentalize alteration instead of lying on its strongest observed anomaly.
difference: The inspected local builder smooths a K alteration halo and DCAP-LHC uses radiometric context; explicit opposite-side endpoint topology is a different proposed interaction, not established as globally novel.
non_fault_mimic: Erosional unconformities, lithologic boundaries or soil-moisture effects.
expected_improvement: Third qualitative rank; physically motivated corroboration, not a calibrated probability or DTI forecast.
viability: Not executable yet: exact band definitions and saturation, original official archive bytes, and authenticated shared derived-cache provenance remain unresolved.

name: Terrain-conditioned thermal sign asymmetry
layers: GDR #1391 well/spring and 2 m probe temperatures with dates; elevation, aspect and drainage position.
signature: Robust terrain-corrected temperature residuals with repeated cross-line sign consistency, rather than nearest-hot-point distance.
missing_fault_rationale: Focused upflow could corroborate concealed permeability away from mapped traces. It does not by itself establish a geothermal vent or a fault.
difference: The inspected local builder smooths probe and well/spring proxies; a terrain/season-conditioned paired residual-sign test is not the same transformation. Peer uniqueness remains unproved.
non_fault_mimic: Groundwater advection, seasonality, pumping or land-use effects.
expected_improvement: Fourth qualitative rank because sparse and seasonally biased sampling may dominate. No numeric DTI projection.
viability: Not executable yet: the official index was readable, but the attempted 2 m probe archive retrieval returned HTTP 500; source bytes, spatial coverage and sampling dates remain unverified.
